review_evidence: Unit-wide inventory covers 203 primary Foundation files spanning propositional/first-order logic, arithmetic, set theory, semantics, proof systems, forcing, completeness/incompleteness and metaprogrammed provers.
Declaration-light Basic/root files are import/public-import aggregation surfaces and are retained.
Foundation/Meta/Test.lean was inspected despite its name: it contains numerous substantive classical and intuitionistic entailment examples over the project proof systems, so it remains searchable.
summary: Reviewed FormalizedFormalLogic Foundation and retained all 203 primary files; test/import naming is not used as an exclusion signal where real formal statements or navigation are present.

review_evidence: Foundation.lean: read header and grep; `module` plus 285 `public import` lines, no declarations: import-only aggregator retained under FILTER-007.

Read completely the import-only aggregators Foundation/FirstOrder/Arithmetic/Bootstrapping/Syntax.lean, Foundation/FirstOrder/Kripke.lean, Foundation/FirstOrder/LK/Completeness.lean, Foundation/FirstOrder/SetTheory/Basic.lean, Foundation/FirstOrder/Arithmetic/Basic.lean, Foundation/FirstOrder/Arithmetic/Exponential.lean, Foundation/FirstOrder/Arithmetic/Definability.lean, Foundation/FirstOrder/Tarski.lean, Foundation/FirstOrder/Syntax.lean: only `module` and `public import` lines; retained as navigation modules (FILTER-007).
Foundation/FirstOrder/Tarski/AesopInit.lean (103 bytes): read completely; `declare_aesop_rule_sets [Definability]`, an executable command, not import-only; retained.

Zoo/Arithmetic.lean and Zoo/ProvabilityLogic.lean: read completely; each defines `public def main` calling Zoo.run over FFL.FirstOrder.ArithmeticTheory / FFL.ProvabilityLogic.Logic reductions; Zoo/Collect.lean header read, 6 def-level declarations for scanning ⪯/⪱/≊ facts; retained.
Foundation/Meta/Test.lean: read completely; 14 `example` statements of classical and intuitionistic entailments proved by cl_prover / cl_prover_2s / int_prover; formal statements, retained.

Smallest declaration-bearing files (e.g. Foundation/Vorspiel/Empty.lean, Foundation/Vorspiel/Small.lean, Foundation/ProvabilityLogic/S/Boxdot.lean, Foundation/FirstOrder/Incompleteness/Löb.lean) have 1 to 4 declaration/command matches; retained.
summary: Surveyed all 282 listed files (all .lean; 153 FirstOrder, 57 ProvabilityLogic, 32 Vorspiel, 13 Propositional, 8 Logic, 6 Meta, 5 Syntax, 4 SecondOrder, Foundation.lean, 3 Zoo) with a per-file declaration/command grep; all 282 exist in the checkout and together hold about 6433 theorem/lemma lines. Twelve files had zero declaration-or-command matches; I read each completely and all are prover-aware import-only aggregators (module + public import lines) or small executables with a def main, so they stay primary-eligible under FILTER-007 (no verified auxiliary delivery path). Remaining files carry theorem/def/instance/example content. No file meets the FILTER-002/FILTER-004 bar for exclusion; all 282 files are retained.

summary: Inspected all 29 listed files. Three files (Foundation.lean, Foundation/FirstOrder/Arithmetic/Basic.lean, Foundation/FirstOrder/Arithmetic/Definability.lean) are pure import aggregators containing only public import statements. The remaining 26 files contain substantial formal mathematical content: definitions, theorems, lemmas, instances, structures, inductive types, and abbreviations across arithmetic, incompleteness, syntax, provability logic, and zoo modules. Under FILTER-007, pure import aggregators are navigation data, but the policy requires verifying the auxiliary delivery path is deployed before exclusion; without such evidence, FILTER-025's default of retain applies. No file meets the FILTER-004 hard-exclusion bar. All 29 files stay in the primary index.
